title: Ring presentations of affine upper-tail charts
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathbf{CRing}$, and let $c$ be a limiting cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ whose vertex is affine [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $i\le j$, $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R(i)$, and let $U$ cover its $j$-base change with affine chart $A=U(a)$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let rep choose representatives of the antisymmetrization of the upper tail $j\le k$, let $t$ be the class of $j$, let $g:A\to\operatorname{Spec}R(j)$ be the second projection, and let $F=\mathrm{rep}\circ\mathrm{upperTailChartDiagram}(R,j,g)^{\mathrm{rightOp}}\circ\Gamma$ [new-affine-chart-upper-tail-limit-data]. Put $s:\operatorname{Spec}R(\mathrm{rep}(t))\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R(j)} A\to A$ and $r_0:F(t)\to\operatorname{colim}F$ the colimit inclusion. Then s is an isomorphism and the direct limit cover chart $W_0=(U.\mathrm{pullback}_1(q_0))(a)$ is affine. There is a ring isomorphism $\rho_0:\operatorname{colim}F\simeq\Gamma(W_0)$ with $\rho_0(r_0(s^\sharp(b)))=q_{0,a}^\sharp(b)$ for $b\in\Gamma(A)$. For every $x\ge t$, let $k=\mathrm{rep}(x)$, let $q$ be the base-change map from stage $k$ to stage $j$, let $p$ be the map from the limit to stage $k$, let $r=F(t\to x)$ and $r_1:F(x)\to\operatorname{colim}F$, and set $U_k=U.\mathrm{pullback}_1(q)$, $V=U_k.\mathrm{pullback}_1(p)$. There is a ring isomorphism $\rho_x:F(x)\simeq\Gamma(U_k(a))$ with $\rho_x(r(s^\sharp(b)))=q_a^\sharp(b)$ for all b, and $U_k(a)$ is affine. For the canonical lift $v:V(a)\to W_0$, the identity $v^\sharp(\rho_0(r_1(b)))=p_a^\sharp(\rho_x(b))$ holds for every $b\in F(x)$. All maps and their pullback lifts are the literal ones in lean.statement. There is no assertion about modules.

proof.text: The representative of t is equivalent to j in the upper-tail preorder, so the transition arrow is an isomorphism, as is its image under R and Spec. Pullback of that isomorphism gives IsIso s.

Apply upperTailChartCone_isLimit. The representative functor is an equivalence of preorder categories with inverse the quotient functor; reindex the cone along it. Every chart and vertex is affine by affine base change. Compare the reindexed cone with Spec of the chosen colimit cocone of F. The spectrum/global-sections equivalence and uniqueness of limits give the vertex ring isomorphism.

Pullback pasting identifies the cone vertex with W0 and its stage x with Uk(a), compatibly with the projections to A. Apply global sections to these isomorphisms to define ρ0,ρx. The projection equations give the two identities on s.appTop(b). On V(a), the cone compatibility at x and the two projection equations for the pasting maps give v.appTop(ρ0(r1(b))) = (Uk.pullbackHom p a).appTop(ρx(b)).

theorem affine_chart_section_ring_presentations
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (a : U.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (U.X a))
    :
    let rep := (OrderEmbedding.ofAntisymmetrization
      (α := {k : I // j ≤ k})).monotone.functor
    let g := U.f a ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))
    let F := rep ⋙ (upperTailChartDiagram R j g).rightOp ⋙ Scheme.Γ
    let t := toAntisymmetrization (· ≤ ·) (⟨j, le_rfl⟩ : {k : I // j ≤ k})
    let kₜ := rep.obj t
    let s := pullback.snd (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE kₜ.property))) g
    let r₀ := (colimit.ι F t).hom
    let q₀ := baseChangeMap f
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
      (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
    IsIso s ∧ IsAffine ((U.pullback₁ q₀).X a) ∧
    ∃ (ρ₀ : ↑(colimit F) ≃+* Γ((U.pullback₁ q₀).X a, ⊤)),
      (∀ b, ρ₀ (r₀ (s.appTop b)) = (U.pullbackHom q₀ a).appTop b) ∧
      ∀ (x : Antisymmetrization {k : I // j ≤ k} (· ≤ ·)) (htx : t ≤ x),
        let k := (rep.obj x).val
        let hjk := (rep.obj x).property
        let q := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
          (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
            (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
        let p := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
        let q₀ := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
        let w : p ≫ q = q₀ := by
          rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
          congr 1
          ext
          simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op
        let r := (F.map (homOfLE htx)).hom
        let r₁ := (colimit.ι F x).hom
        let Uk : (pullback f (Spec.map
          (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
        let V : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).OpenCover.{u} := Uk.pullback₁ p
        let v : V.X a ⟶ (U.pullback₁ q₀).X a := pullback.lift (V.f a)
          (Uk.pullbackHom p a ≫ U.pullbackHom q a)
          (by
            dsimp only [V]
            rw [Category.assoc, U.pullbackHom_map,
              ← Category.assoc, Uk.pullbackHom_map, Category.assoc, w])
        ∃ (ρₓ : ↑(F.obj x) ≃+* Γ((U.pullback₁ q).X a, ⊤)),
          (∀ b, ρₓ (r (s.appTop b)) = (U.pullbackHom q a).appTop b) ∧
          IsAffine (Uk.X a) ∧
          (∀ b, v.appTop (ρ₀ (r₁ b)) = (Uk.pullbackHom p a).appTop (ρₓ b))
